vote.question: Community Accountability Resolution [US-MT U.S. Senate]: Kurt Alme (R) has received $3,013,681 in career campaign contributions (anchored this cycle by Koch Inc. ($30,000,000) and $95,500,000 from top-5 patrons)—linked to "Extractive Energy & Petrochemical Capture". Should MT release the community fund to local charities working on clean water remediation, community grid resilience, and environmental health clinics?
vote.futarchy_thesis: Large campaign contributions create public concern over policy priorities. When Kurt Alme receives $3,013,681 (anchored this cycle by Koch Inc. ($30,000,000) and $95,500,000 from top-5 patrons), community members want accountability. This fund lets residents decide whether to direct community resources to local public causes.
options: Yes — Send Fund to Local Charities
No — Send Fund to Essential Community Services

outcomes.YES_RELEASE_TO_LOCAL_CHARITIES: Directs 100% of the funds to verified local non-profits working directly on state community needs.
outcomes.NO_RELEASE_TO_COMMUNITY_COMMONS: Directs 100% of the funds to bipartisan, universal local public services (volunteer fire/EMS, veterans' care, food banks, disaster relief).
outcomes.ABSTAIN_LOG_DISSENT: Records resident feedback without moving the vote count.

futarchy_pole_mechanics.leverage_ratio_statement: Every contribution directly empowers community-led funding. Once the campaign pool reaches $10,000, an automatic 60-day countdown begins. When the 60 days expire, all funds go directly to verified local charities or essential community services—zero platform cut.

bounty_if_passed.description: Community Fund for US-MT: Delivers 100% of funds to verified, IRS-registered 501(c)(3) public charities serving MT dedicated to clean water remediation, community grid resilience, and environmental health clinics. Verified local recipients: MONTANA LAND RELIANCE (US-EIN:810369262); FLATHEAD LAND TRUST INC (US-EIN:363479966); PRICKLY PEAR LAND TRUST (US-EIN:810506868); MONTANA LAND RELIANCE FOUNDATION (US-EIN:271125289); YELLOWSTONE TO YUKON CONSERVATION INITIATIVE (US-EIN:810535303). Once the pool hits $10,000, a 60-day timer starts. If YES wins, funds go to these charities; if NO wins, funds go to local community commons (fire/EMS, veterans, food banks).
bounty_if_passed.destination_criteria: All recipient organizations must be active, verified 501(c)(3) public charities registered in US-MT with clean IRS status and direct community impact. Approved charities: MONTANA LAND RELIANCE (US-EIN:810369262); FLATHEAD LAND TRUST INC (US-EIN:363479966); PRICKLY PEAR LAND TRUST (US-EIN:810506868); MONTANA LAND RELIANCE FOUNDATION (US-EIN:271125289); YELLOWSTONE TO YUKON CONSERVATION INITIATIVE (US-EIN:810535303).

trigger_conditions: Condition 1 (Activation): The campaign activates its 60-day countdown timer as soon as total contributions reach $10,000 USD (Base USDC).
Condition 2 (Resolution Period): The community vote runs for exactly 60 days from the moment the $10,000 threshold is reached.

Condition 3 (Payout): If YES receives 60% or more of votes, 100% of the funds are sent to the verified state non-profits; otherwise, 100% is sent to universal community services (fire/EMS, veterans, food banks).

bounty_if_no_wins.description: Community Commons for US-MT: If residents decide against the restitution fund, 100% of the funds go directly to essential local community services in US-MT (Volunteer Fire/EMS, Veterans' Care, Food Banks, and Disaster Relief). Recipient non-profits: YELLOWSTONE MOUNTAIN CLUB PUBLIC SAFETY AND PRIVACY INC (US-EIN:201729501); BIG SKY BRAVERY FOUNDATION (US-EIN:473983634); BILLINGS FOOD BANK INC (US-EIN:363519470); BILLINGS CLINIC (US-EIN:810231784); YELLOWSTONE BOYS & GIRLS RANCH (US-EIN:810262019).
bounty_if_no_wins.candidate_benefit_attestation: Issues immutable on-chain 'CONSTITUENT_MANDATE_VINDICATED' attestation for Kurt Alme (US-MT) and credits the constituency's defense of the candidate for funding front-line state humanitarian & emergency infrastructure.
bounty_if_no_wins.destination_criteria: MUST be an IRS-audited 501(c)(3) public charity in US-MT operating in non-ideological universal commons (NTEE M24 Fire & Rescue, M20 Disaster Relief, W30 Veterans, K31 Food Banks, E20/E22 Community Hospitals, O Youth Development) with zero partisan lobbying, chosen only where both sides of the political divide benefit. Eligible commons beneficiaries: YELLOWSTONE MOUNTAIN CLUB PUBLIC SAFETY AND PRIVACY INC (US-EIN:201729501); BIG SKY BRAVERY FOUNDATION (US-EIN:473983634); BILLINGS FOOD BANK INC (US-EIN:363519470); BILLINGS CLINIC (US-EIN:810231784); YELLOWSTONE BOYS & GIRLS RANCH (US-EIN:810262019).
